name: ui-tag-input
description: TagInput — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui tag-input pattern).

schema.description: TagInput — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui tag-input pattern).
schema.name: ui-tag-input

addEvent.description: Event emitted when a tag is added: `UI:{addEvent}` with payload `{ tag: string, value: string[] }`.
addEvent.label: Add Event

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the outer container.
className.label: Class Name

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

helperText.description: Helper text rendered under the input.
helperText.label: Helper Text

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

onChange.description: Direct callback emitted on every change. Stays as the Storybook / non-trait contract; trait-driven schemas should prefer the bus events below.
onChange.label: On Change

placeholder.description: Placeholder for the entry input. Default: `'Type and press Enter…'`.
placeholder.label: Placeholder

removeEvent.description: Event emitted when a tag is removed: `UI:{removeEvent}` with payload `{ tag: string, index: number, value: string[] }`.
removeEvent.label: Remove Event

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

skeleton.description: Skeleton shown while this element's server render is in flight: a shape (`table`, `list`, …), `{ variant, rows?, columns?, fields? }`, or `none`.
skeleton.label: Skeleton

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

variant.description: Variant applied to each chip Badge. Default: `'default'`.
variant.label: Variant

emits.description: Direct callback emitted on every change. Stays as the Storybook / non-trait contract; trait-driven schemas should prefer the bus events below.
Event emitted when a tag is added: `UI:{addEvent}` with payload `{ tag: string, value: string[] }`.
Event emitted when a tag is removed: `UI:{removeEvent}` with payload `{ tag: string, index: number, value: string[] }`.

events.description: Direct callback emitted on every change. Stays as the Storybook / non-trait contract; trait-driven schemas should prefer the bus events below.
events.name: @config.on change

events.description: Event emitted when a tag is added: `UI:{addEvent}` with payload `{ tag: string, value: string[] }`.
events.name: @config.add event

events.description: Event emitted when a tag is removed: `UI:{removeEvent}` with payload `{ tag: string, index: number, value: string[] }`.
events.name: @config.remove event
